notes: Apple Devices tab is now wired to real device-reading tools. One-time setup: install Apple's Mobile Device driver (iTunes or the free 'Apple Devices' app), then use the new 'Install from file…' button to add a vetted copy of the open-source libimobiledevice tools — they save onto your USB stick and travel with it. The app looks for them on the stick first, so no rebuild is needed. (For safety the app never auto-downloads these binaries; you supply a copy you trust.) Once installed, connect an iPhone/iPad, unlock and tap Trust, then Read device.
